name: woj_pong

tests.description: initialize Pong state and apply opposite paddle inputs for one tick
drive a paddle into its clamp limit over repeated ticks
run long enough to bounce off the bottom wall and collide with the right paddle

source.description: Pong example from the WOJ language repository.

description: WOJ Pong example compiled to WasmGC, driven through initialized state, paddle input, clamping, ball movement, wall bounce, and paddle collision behavior.
notes: Tests initialize the Pong state and drive actual game ticks. They assert paddle input movement, clamp behavior, ball position integration, bottom-wall bounce, right-paddle collision, and unchanged score counters.
